presets.title: Gather design context
presets.description: Understand the product, users, existing design, and constraints before design work, and connect to the design system preset when the work needs one.

presets.title: Shape a feature
presets.description: Work out a feature or screen's purpose, users, flow, states, and scope as a confirmed brief before anything is built.

presets.title: Document the design system
presets.description: Record the shipped design system as a rules document for agents and a design-system canvas that references the project's token CSS.

presets.title: Extract reusable patterns
presets.description: Find tokens, components, and patterns the design repeats and propose how to consolidate them; refactor app code only on request.

presets.title: Critique the design
presets.description: Review the UX, hierarchy, and communication of a named design and report prioritized findings without editing.

presets.title: Audit the design
presets.description: Check accessibility, responsiveness, theming, and performance risks, separating what was verified from what was not.

presets.title: Polish the details
presets.description: Finish a design for consistency and completeness while keeping its identity, content, and function.

presets.title: Simplify the design
presets.description: Remove redundant elements, noise, and complexity without dropping function or product facts the user has not agreed to cut.

presets.title: Make it bolder
presets.description: Strengthen the visual emphasis of the requested target using the design system's own vocabulary.

presets.title: Calm the design
presets.description: Soften excessive color, weight, decoration, and motion while keeping hierarchy and character.

presets.title: Improve the layout
presets.description: Improve arrangement, spacing, grouping, and reading order so product priority reads clearly at every covered width.

presets.title: Improve the typography
presets.description: Improve fonts, type hierarchy, and readability using the project's type tokens, without replacing an established identity.

presets.title: Improve the color
presets.description: Improve color roles and contrast with token CSS variables while keeping brand colors and meaning intact.

presets.title: Clarify copy
presets.description: Clarify labels, errors, and next actions without changing meaning.

presets.title: Harden for real conditions
presets.description: Add error, empty, loading, permission, offline, and extreme-content states so a design holds up with real data.

presets.title: Design first use
presets.description: Design first-run flows, empty states, and next actions that get new users to a real result without invented claims.

presets.title: Adapt to other contexts
presets.description: Restructure a screen for other widths, devices, inputs, or contexts instead of stretching it.

presets.title: Add purposeful motion
presets.description: Design motion that explains state, relationship, and feedback, with reduced-motion and performance care.

presets.title: Add moments of delight
presets.description: Add product-specific personality at moments that earn it, without slowing tasks or touching serious moments.

presets.title: Generate design alternatives
presets.description: Draw the design alternatives the user asked for on a canvas, varied on distinct axes, without choosing or adopting one.
